phases.name: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
phases.description: Build a versioned, deduplicated incident signal from monitored infrastructure before any automation can act.

phases.name: Select a playbook and enforce safety
phases.description: Use dependency context and versioned playbooks, then require explicit policy and approval before risky work.

phases.name: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
phases.description: Carry only authorized commands through a durable queue and prove health before expanding their scope.

phases.name: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
phases.description: Keep a complete action ledger, measure verified success, and train only from reviewed outcome evidence.

phases.name: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
phases.description: Test scenario breadth, canary and rollback behavior, then expose residual risks and measurable release gates.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Freeze the operational contract
steps.content: The live brief requires detection-to-verified-remediation within 5 minutes, a remediation success rate above 90%, zero unintended side effects, coverage of 100+ distinct failure scenarios, and an audit trail for every automated action. Treat these as acceptance targets to measure in drills and production, not outcomes guaranteed by a diagram. This draft assumes an initial Kubernetes estate; the control plane remains portable to other infrastructure adapters.

steps.title: Identify remediation targets
steps.content: Scope every action to a concrete resource and failure domain, with an observed version so stale incidents cannot mutate a changed target.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Timestamped anomaly candidates
steps.content: The message is evidence, not permission to remediate.

connection.description: Publish candidate alerts with target, signal, event time, source, and deduplication key.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Correlate symptoms into incidents
steps.content: Stateful windows deduplicate alert storms; late events and missing data remain visible to operators.

component.description: Join related alerts in bounded windows, suppress duplicates, and group incidents by dependency and failure domain.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Ordered incident candidates
steps.content: Backpressure must delay low-priority work before it creates conflicting remediation attempts.

connection.label: Ordered incident candidates
connection.description: Consume with idempotent offsets and a bounded retry path; partition ownership keeps one failure domain ordered.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Rank anomalies without authorizing writes
steps.content: Keep a model version, confidence, drift signal, and feature provenance; a model prediction alone cannot approve an infrastructure mutation.

component.description: Versioned anomaly ranking model used only as one signal alongside deterministic thresholds and topology checks.

properties.purpose: Versioned anomaly ranking model used only as one signal alongside deterministic thresholds and topology checks.

component.highlightReason: Keep a model version, confidence, drift signal, and feature provenance; a model prediction alone cannot approve an infrastructure mutation.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Bounded anomaly inference
steps.content: A model outage should reduce automation confidence, not disable incident visibility.

connection.label: Bounded anomaly inference
connection.description: Send normalized features and a deadline to the pinned model version; time out to deterministic detection rules.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Score and model provenance
steps.content: Record uncertainty so low-confidence incidents are held for triage instead of selecting risky playbooks.

connection.label: Score and model provenance
connection.description: Return score, model version, and confidence for the correlated incident.

steps.phase: Detect and correlate infrastructure anomalies
steps.title: Choose deduplication before action
steps.content: Use bounded windows and versioned incident keys; retain separate symptoms for diagnosis even when one root incident owns remediation.

decision.question: Can every alert start its own remediation?
decision.chosen: Correlate and deduplicate per failure domain before opening one incident.
decision.chosenReason: An alert storm during a cascade otherwise launches competing playbooks against the same dependency.

alternatives.tradeoff: Fast for isolated events but creates duplicate and conflicting actions.
Can conceal a real new failure after the first alert.

properties.purpose: Join alerts in bounded windows, deduplicate by incident and failure domain, preserve late evidence, and emit one action candidate with confidence and source provenance.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Add dependency context
steps.content: A cascade should be coordinated around its likely root cause; stale topology increases blast-radius risk and must lower automation confidence.

component.label: Service Dependency Graph
component.description: Versioned service-to-resource dependencies, owners, and failure-domain relationships used for blast-radius estimates.

properties.purpose: Versioned service-to-resource dependencies, owners, and failure-domain relationships used for blast-radius estimates.

component.highlightReason: A cascade should be coordinated around its likely root cause; stale topology increases blast-radius risk and must lower automation confidence.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Affected service lookup
steps.content: Do not remediate each downstream symptom independently when a shared dependency is failing.

connection.label: Affected service lookup
connection.description: Resolve upstream and downstream dependencies for the incident's resource version and time.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Coordinate one incident lifecycle
steps.content: Persist incident state and idempotency keys; rank known playbooks by preconditions, risk, and evidence rather than letting an ML score execute a command.

component.label: Remediation Coordinator
component.description: Per-incident state machine for diagnosis, playbook selection, policy checks, coordinated rollout, verification, and rollback.

properties.purpose: Per-incident state machine for diagnosis, playbook selection, policy checks, coordinated rollout, verification, and rollback.
properties.steps: correlate -> diagnose -> match -> authorize -> canary -> verify -> expand or rollback -> audit

component.highlightReason: Persist incident state and idempotency keys; rank known playbooks by preconditions, risk, and evidence rather than letting an ML score execute a command.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Correlated incident
steps.content: The timer for the five-minute target starts at detection, not when a worker begins.

connection.label: Correlated incident
connection.description: Provide incident key, affected targets, confidence, symptom set, and first-detection timestamp.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Topology and blast radius
steps.content: If topology is stale or incomplete, choose observation or approval rather than pretending the blast radius is known.

connection.label: Topology and blast radius
connection.description: Read dependency version, failure-domain ownership, and estimated downstream impact before action.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Register known failure playbooks
steps.content: Catalog 100+ distinct failure scenarios by signature and affected service; version and test every playbook. A catalog target is not proof that 100 playbooks already exist.

component.label: Versioned Remediation Playbooks
component.description: Signed Ansible runbooks with scenario taxonomy, preconditions, bounded commands, verification, and compensating rollback.

properties.purpose: Signed Ansible runbooks with scenario taxonomy, preconditions, bounded commands, verification, and compensating rollback.

component.highlightReason: Catalog 100+ distinct failure scenarios by signature and affected service; version and test every playbook. A catalog target is not proof that 100 playbooks already exist.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Precondition-matched runbook
steps.content: Reject ambiguous matches and missing preconditions; do not synthesize new shell commands from model output.

connection.label: Precondition-matched runbook
connection.description: Fetch a pinned, signed playbook version with prerequisites, risk class, blast-radius limit, verification, and rollback.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Add a fail-closed policy boundary
steps.content: Recheck target version and dependency state immediately before issuing a short-lived execution permit.

component.label: Safety Policy Engine
component.description: Fail-closed authorization service for preconditions, dry-run results, blast radius, change windows, approval, and action budgets.

properties.purpose: Fail-closed authorization service for preconditions, dry-run results, blast radius, change windows, approval, and action budgets.

component.highlightReason: Recheck target version and dependency state immediately before issuing a short-lived execution permit.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Action proposal and evidence
steps.content: The coordinator proposes; the policy engine is the only route to execution.

connection.label: Action proposal and evidence
connection.description: Submit target identity, runbook digest, risk class, dry-run result, blast radius, incident key, and expiry.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Fence concurrent remediation
steps.content: A lease prevents a cascade from running competing fixes; expiry and fencing protect against paused or restarted workers.

component.label: Failure-Domain Action Lease
component.description: Fenced lease by service and failure domain, with expiry and monotonically increasing token.

properties.purpose: Fenced lease by service and failure domain, with expiry and monotonically increasing token.

component.highlightReason: A lease prevents a cascade from running competing fixes; expiry and fencing protect against paused or restarted workers.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Fenced action lease
steps.content: A stale worker without the current token must be rejected by the target adapter.

connection.label: Fenced action lease
connection.description: Acquire a domain-scoped lease and attach its fencing token to every execution permit.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Expose critical decisions to operators
steps.content: Use named RBAC roles and an expiring, incident-bound approval for destructive or broad actions; preserve the human-in-the-loop hint.

component.label: Operator Approval Console
component.description: Authenticated view of incident evidence, runbook diff, risk, proposed scope, and signed approval or denial.

properties.purpose: Authenticated view of incident evidence, runbook diff, risk, proposed scope, and signed approval or denial.

component.highlightReason: Use named RBAC roles and an expiring, incident-bound approval for destructive or broad actions; preserve the human-in-the-loop hint.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: High-risk approval request
steps.content: A pending approval does not silently become permission when the five-minute timer is nearly over.

connection.label: High-risk approval request
connection.description: Present the exact target, playbook digest, blast-radius estimate, rollback plan, and expiry.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Signed approval or denial
steps.content: The permit must fail closed on timeout, revocation, or mismatched target and runbook digest.

connection.label: Signed approval or denial
connection.description: Return authenticated approver identity, scoped decision, expiry, and immutable reason.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Gate destructive and broad actions
steps.content: If approval cannot arrive within five minutes, report a missed timing target and leave the risky action blocked; safety takes precedence over the timing objective.

decision.question: Should every matched runbook execute without a person?
decision.chosen: Auto-execute only known, reversible runbooks preapproved for unattended execution. Require explicit operator approval before any novel or low-confidence action and before destructive or high-blast-radius actions.
decision.chosenReason: This reconciles the brief's automation goal with its zero-side-effects constraint and human-in-the-loop hint: only known, preapproved reversible actions run unattended; uncertainty or risk needs an accountable operator.

alternatives.tradeoff: May be faster but exposes unrelated infrastructure to unbounded side effects.
Safer but can miss the five-minute recovery target for routine low-risk fixes.

properties.purpose: Fail closed unless preconditions, target version, dry run, blast radius, fenced lease, action budget, and policy pass. Unattended execution is limited to known, reversible runbooks preapproved for that scope; novel, low-confidence, destructive, or high-blast-radius actions require scoped operator approval before a short-lived permit.

steps.phase: Select a playbook and enforce safety
steps.title: Versioned blast-radius evidence
steps.content: A stale dependency snapshot invalidates the permit instead of allowing a broad remediation.

connection.label: Versioned blast-radius evidence
connection.description: Supply dependency and ownership snapshot used in the permit decision.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Queue permitted actions
steps.content: Use delayed retries and a dead-letter path for exhausted jobs; a duplicate delivery must not repeat a mutation.

component.label: Authorized Action Queue
component.description: Durable jobs containing only a signed permit, pinned playbook digest, idempotency key, target version, and deadline.

properties.purpose: Durable jobs containing only a signed permit, pinned playbook digest, idempotency key, target version, and deadline.

component.highlightReason: Use delayed retries and a dead-letter path for exhausted jobs; a duplicate delivery must not repeat a mutation.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Short-lived execution permit
steps.content: No coordinator-to-worker bypass may skip the safety gate.

connection.label: Short-lived execution permit
connection.description: Enqueue only after policy and lease approval; include exact scope, expiry, and fencing token.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Add isolated execution workers
steps.content: Eight workers are an initial capacity assumption; per-failure-domain fencing and quotas still serialize conflicting actions.

component.label: Remediation Executor
component.description: Isolated worker that verifies permit and target version, runs a one-target canary, checks health, expands boundedly, or runs rollback.

properties.purpose: Isolated worker that verifies permit and target version, runs a one-target canary, checks health, expands boundedly, or runs rollback.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Idempotent action job
steps.content: Workers recheck permit expiry, lease token, and target version on every retry.

connection.label: Idempotent action job
connection.description: Deliver a bounded job with permit and deadline; acknowledge only after durable outcome recording.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Limit executor authority
steps.content: Fetch short-lived credentials only after permit verification; no standing cluster-admin secret belongs in a playbook.

component.label: Short-Lived Execution Credentials
component.description: Per-target, least-privilege credentials with rotation, encryption, and access audit.

properties.purpose: Per-target, least-privilege credentials with rotation, encryption, and access audit.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Scoped execution credential
steps.content: Revoke or expire credentials after the action; credential access is included in the audit trail.

connection.label: Scoped execution credential
connection.description: Request credentials bound to target, permitted verbs, runbook digest, and expiry.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Pinned command and compensation
steps.content: Refuse execution if the fetched digest differs from the signed permit.

connection.label: Pinned command and compensation
connection.description: Fetch the approved immutable playbook and its inverse or restore checkpoint.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Canary, bounded rollout, or compensation
steps.content: Rollback uses a separately approved compensating step or a captured checkpoint; an action without safe rollback needs stronger approval.

connection.label: Canary, bounded rollout, or compensation
connection.description: Apply with compare-and-swap target version and fencing token; first change one instance, then expand only after verification.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Independent health post-check
steps.content: A command exiting zero is not a successful remediation; verify both the repaired symptom and unrelated service health.

connection.label: Independent health post-check
connection.description: Read service SLOs and target health against the pre-action baseline with a bounded observation window.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Verified outcome or rollback request
steps.content: The coordinator decides whether to expand, roll back, or stop and escalate.

connection.label: Verified outcome or rollback request
connection.description: Return command result, post-check evidence, scope reached, timestamps, and compensation status.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Use a one-target canary
steps.content: If the canary degrades a dependency or lacks sufficient post-check evidence, stop expansion and initiate the compensation path.

decision.question: Should the runbook roll out to all affected targets immediately?
decision.chosen: Fix one instance, verify symptom and guardrail metrics, then expand in bounded batches.
decision.chosenReason: A successful dry run cannot reveal every production dependency; the canary limits first exposure.

alternatives.tradeoff: Faster nominal recovery but a bad playbook has a large blast radius.
Limits exposure but leaves a multi-instance incident unresolved.

properties.purpose: Verify permit, target version, and fenced lease; run one-target canary with pre/post health checks, then expand in bounded batches only while guardrails remain healthy.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Rollback failed or harmful changes
steps.content: A non-reversible action is not eligible for unattended execution; capture a restore point and a tested compensation procedure first.

decision.question: What happens when post-checks fail after mutation?
decision.chosen: Stop new jobs, run the pinned compensation or restore checkpoint, verify recovery, and escalate if rollback fails.
decision.chosenReason: A command success without healthy service outcomes is a failure; rollback itself can fail and must be audited.

alternatives.tradeoff: Can amplify an outage and bypass the five-minute deadline.
Hides a second failure mode and can create unintended side effects.

properties.purpose: Verify permit and fenced lease; canary one target, check symptom and unrelated SLOs, expand only within budget, and on failed checks stop, run pinned compensation or restore checkpoint, verify rollback, and escalate an incomplete recovery.

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Coordinate cascading failures
steps.content: Use the dependency graph and fenced lease to hold downstream playbooks until the root-cause action is verified; escalate when ownership is ambiguous.

decision.question: Should each downstream symptom launch its own fix?
decision.chosen: Elect one root incident owner per dependency and failure domain, then sequence dependent actions.
decision.chosenReason: Concurrent fixes can cancel one another or mask the root cause during a cascade.

alternatives.tradeoff: Reduces queue time but risks contradictory actions.

alternatives.option: Wait for every alert to clear before acting
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids conflicts but delays the root fix without a bounded decision.

properties.steps: correlate -> choose root incident -> match pinned playbook -> authorize and fence -> canary -> verify -> sequence dependent actions -> expand or compensate -> audit

steps.phase: Execute a canary, verify, and rollback
steps.title: Protect the five-minute action budget
steps.content: Budget detection, correlation, policy, queue, canary, post-check, and rollback; report each stage separately. A timed-out permit fails closed even if the SLO is missed.

scaleTrigger.metric: p95 detection-to-verified-remediation latency; oldest authorized job age and active leases
scaleTrigger.action: Scale workers and partitions within per-domain quotas; shed or escalate low-confidence candidates before they crowd out verified incidents.
scaleTrigger.impact: More workers improve independent incident throughput but do not bypass a safety permit or shorten human approval.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Command and rollback outcome
steps.content: If the audit store is unavailable, hold new mutations or use a bounded durable write-ahead spool; never silently drop action evidence.

connection.label: Command and rollback outcome
connection.description: Append exact command digest, target version, scope, observed health, compensation, and verification status.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Measure outcomes rather than command exits
steps.content: Define success as verified recovery without unintended side effects; count failed rollback separately. The above-90% target needs a stated denominator and observation window.

component.label: Remediation Outcome Analytics
component.description: Compute verified success, rollback, side-effect, latency, and scenario coverage by playbook and failure domain.

properties.purpose: Compute verified success, rollback, side-effect, latency, and scenario coverage by playbook and failure domain.

component.highlightReason: Define success as verified recovery without unintended side effects; count failed rollback separately. The above-90% target needs a stated denominator and observation window.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Unsampled action outcomes
steps.content: Do not sample away rare harmful outcomes. Report numerator, denominator, and confidence before claiming above 90%.

connection.label: Unsampled action outcomes
connection.description: Derive success and latency from complete ledger records; classify held, failed, rolled-back, and verified actions distinctly.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Learn reviewed operator patterns
steps.content: Treat operator feedback as evidence for reviewed training candidates, never as permission to authorize or silently promote a new executable runbook. Use actions as labeled examples only after outcome and policy review.

component.label: Operator Pattern Learner
component.description: Offline training from reviewed operator interventions and verified outcomes; feedback creates candidates only, which remain shadow-only until separately reviewed and approved for promotion.

properties.purpose: Offline training from reviewed operator interventions and verified outcomes; feedback creates candidates only, which remain shadow-only until separately reviewed and approved for promotion.

component.highlightReason: Turn operator actions into labeled examples only after outcome and policy review; do not let a model silently invent or publish executable runbooks.

steps.title: Verified outcome labels
steps.content: Exclude unverified or policy-denied interventions from positive training labels.

connection.label: Verified outcome labels
connection.description: Provide incident features, chosen action, post-check, side effects, and rollback labels with lineage.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Reviewed operator intervention
steps.content: Operator behavior alone is not proof the action was safe or effective.

connection.label: Reviewed operator intervention
connection.description: Capture operator choice and rationale linked to the incident and observed outcome.

steps.phase: Audit outcomes and learn from operators
steps.title: Shadow candidate model
steps.content: Learning should improve ranking while the safety engine remains authoritative for execution.

connection.label: Shadow candidate model

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Test the whole safety envelope

component.description: Scenario matrix for 100+ distinct failures, cascades, stale topology, credential loss, audit outage, bad canary, and rollback failure.

properties.purpose: Scenario matrix for 100+ distinct failures, cascades, stale topology, credential loss, audit outage, bad canary, and rollback failure.

component.highlightReason: Use replay, fault injection, and chaos drills to prove playbook preconditions, bounded blast radius, compensation, and audit under adverse conditions.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Scenario-to-playbook validation
steps.content: The 100+ requirement requires a populated taxonomy plus passing fixtures; the architecture alone does not satisfy the count.

connection.label: Scenario-to-playbook validation

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Adversarial permit tests
steps.content: Require the policy to deny unsafe actions and record every denial before a playbook is eligible for production.

connection.label: Adversarial permit tests
connection.description: Inject stale resource versions, revoked approval, expired lease, broad scope, missing rollback, and audit-store failure.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Surface unsafe or unresolved incidents
steps.content: Automatic low-risk repair can proceed without a person, but critical decisions and failed recovery need an accountable human path.

component.label: Escalation Notifications
component.description: Notify operators of approval requests, unresolved cascades, missed deadlines, failed rollback, and policy denials.

properties.purpose: Notify operators of approval requests, unresolved cascades, missed deadlines, failed rollback, and policy denials.

component.highlightReason: Automatic low-risk repair can proceed without a person, but critical decisions and failed recovery need an accountable human path.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Approval, timeout, and rollback escalation
steps.content: A notification is not approval and must not be interpreted as one.

connection.label: Approval, timeout, and rollback escalation
connection.description: Send incident ID, evidence, required action, owner, and deadline; retry notifications without retrying unsafe mutations.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Promote learning only after review
steps.content: Track model version, data lineage, and false-positive rates; a failed candidate can be rolled back without changing the execution policy.

decision.question: Can a new operator action become an executable remediation automatically?
decision.chosen: Keep learned patterns in shadow mode; require reviewed outcomes, tests, a signed playbook version, and policy approval before promotion. Operator feedback alone never promotes a pattern.
decision.chosenReason: This separates adaptive diagnosis and operator feedback from the reviewed authority to mutate production infrastructure.

alternatives.tradeoff: Can encode one-off mistakes and unmeasured side effects.
Preserves static behavior but misses useful new remediation patterns.

properties.purpose: Train on reviewed operator interventions and verified outcomes; operator feedback alone cannot promote automation. Keep candidate patterns shadow-only until scenario tests, rollback drills, a signed playbook version, and policy approval permit controlled promotion.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: Review capacity and release gates
steps.content: Release evidence must demonstrate under-five-minute detection-to-verified-recovery where autonomous repair applies, above-90% verified success, zero observed unintended side effects, 100+ covered scenarios, and a complete action audit trail. None is established by this draft alone.

scaleTrigger.metric: Verified remediation latency p95, success numerator/denominator, unintended side-effect count, and passing scenario count
scaleTrigger.action: Increase independent incident capacity only after canary, rollback, audit, and approval gates pass under load.
scaleTrigger.impact: More throughput can increase collision risk; retain per-domain fencing and bounded blast radius.

steps.phase: Exercise failure cases and operate against targets
steps.title: State remaining policy tradeoff
steps.content: The brief asks for remediation without human intervention while its hint calls for human-in-the-loop critical decisions. Resolve that tension by auto-executing only known, reversible runbooks preapproved for unattended execution. Require operator approval for novel, low-confidence, destructive, or high-blast-radius actions; operator feedback alone cannot promote new automation. Report a five-minute miss rather than bypassing a safety gate. Validate runbook preapproval, measured latency, rollback semantics, 100+ scenario coverage, and zero-side-effects evidence before release.
